column1: # Ledger edits that are carried but not yet landed.
# The ledger is one shared file under one lease, so an agent that has carried a
# row but cannot take the lease stages it here instead of holding the file open
# between batches. Apply the whole queue with
#     python3 conformance/flip-row.py --from-queue conformance/queued-ledger-edits.tsv
# and verify it without writing the ledger with the same command plus --check,
# which reports how many rows would change and leaves the file's sha alone.
# A row is removed once it lands: the tsv's own rust column is the record from
# then on, and a file that holds landed rows reads as pending work.
# Do not add a row here without its witness already in the tree. flip-row.py
# refuses a `ported` row with an empty rust column, so a queue entry is a claim
# that the test exists.
# Batch 1, thirty rows, landed in 8ea093f: thirteen newly carried in
# Schema.test.ts, seven carrying the allOf intersections in
# fromJsonSchemaDocument.test.ts, ten re-points of rows that were already
# `ported` while citing the wrong witness, and eight excusals of rows whose
# bodies assert nothing at runtime. `git show 8ea093f -- conformance/behavior-tests.tsv`
# is the batch.
# path
# Landed (60 rows in one call) after BoldKite released the ledger lease.
# Batch 2, seven rows from elm-effect-rs-port-managedruntime-oupl. Witnesses live in
# crates/elm-effect/tests/managed_runtime.rs (7 tests, all green). Queue staged
# because BoldKite holds the ledger lease for elm-effect-rs-sgze and did not answer
# a request-release; landed once the lease was free.
# Batch 3, twenty-one rows from elm-effect-rs-port-txpriorityqueue-69y4 (landed). Witnesses in
# crates/elm-effect/tests/tx_priority_queue.rs (21 tests, green under --features stm).
# Batch 4, five rows from elm-effect-rs-port-schema-a2c (landed): the
# resolveAnnotations / resolveAnnotationsKey getters. Witnesses in
# crates/elm-effect-schema/tests/schema_annotations.rs (8 tests, green).
# Batch 5, six rows from elm-effect-rs-port-schema-a2c (landed): the brand and
# fromBrand describes. Witnesses in
# crates/elm-effect-schema/tests/schema_transform.rs (green).
# Batch 6, twenty-one rows from elm-effect-rs-port-schema-a2c (landed): the top-level
# constructor rows at :5216-:5586. Six are carried (the four StringFrom*
# transforms, whose witnesses are in tests/schema_transform.rs and whose
# implementations are in src/transform.rs; plus the two DateTimeUtc rows whose
# wire side is a string or a number the port already has). Fifteen are
# excused because the row's wire value is a JS/Effect value type with no
# Unknown variant, each named in its own reason rather than as one block.
